column7: ADR-112 gap check: an upgraded deployment in the enable_file_permission_check grace period (key absent, users exist, no adr112.file_permission_check.enforced marker; a failed startup check only warns) is a counted admin validate --posture deviation, while a fresh install and a ratcheted deployment are not. The registry side (security.insecure_skip_startup_validation in effect for off and grace-warn-only, a distinct settings-diff value per state) is TestInsecureSkipStartupValidation_GracePeriodIsADeviation / _SettingsDiffSeesEveryState; the boot warning side is TestResolveADR112BootPosture_GracePeriodWarnsAndIsDiffed
